title: The Hidden Secrets of Radiology
subtitle: Dr. Ayoub & Dr. Nadia are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 📷

Dr. Ayoub was certain: radiology was simple, a click and done. But his first X-ray changed everything...

'Why is my X-ray blurry? Why is there this shadow on the apex? And this patient, is he really well protected?'

Dr. Nadia, the practice's expert, then challenged him: 'In this quiz, you will dive into the secrets of radiology. From images that reveal the invisible, to the risks of radiation protection, to the errors that can distort everything.'

Between a poorly interpreted X-ray and a lesion gone unnoticed, the diagnosis is at stake.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Ayoub was certain: radiology was simple. He discovers the basics of dental radiology, imaging techniques, dosimetry, and radiation protection principles.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia deepen their knowledge of technical parameters (kV, mA), radiographic incidences, cephalometry, and anatomical landmarks.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia face complex situations: advanced settings, image optimization, artifacts, image interpretation. They must master every parameter for a precise diagnosis.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia manage complex cases: pathologies, lesions, differential diagnoses, 3D imaging. They must adapt their approach to each clinical situation.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia become references in radiology. They train young dentists on the importance of imaging for diagnosis and treatment planning.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and innovation, Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of radiological skills and excellence to the dental profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Ayoub has laid the foundations of radiology. But the road ahead is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Techniques and incidences are mastered. Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia are ready for more complex cases.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Technical mastery is acquired. Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Complex cases are mastered. Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Diagnostic strategy has become a key skill. Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Ayoub and Dr. Nadia have accomplished their mission. Radiology is the eye of diagnosis.
